review.gallery: Nine original brochure renders show the actual project design, its exterior and interiors. Riviera destination photography was excluded.
review.location: The original brochure map shows the location and ten approximate routes. The broker mirror is attributed at the map and travel links.
review.floorPlans: Eight full brochure pages and five original transparent website drawings. The divergent printed penthouse totals are retained and qualified. Website images have a dark viewing background for their white linework.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates and measured areas for the numbered website drawings were not established. Confirm the final Sky Mansion area against the unit documentation.
